public.title: N-Queens
public.description: Return every placement of n nonattacking queens on an n by n board. Represent a placement as an array of zero-based column indices, one per row. Sort placements lexicographically by numeric column sequence. n is 1 to 8. Queens cannot share columns or diagonals.
hints: Place one queen per row and reject occupied columns or diagonals.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Trying columns ascending in row order naturally emits lexicographic placements. Backtracking prunes conflicting partial boards. Worst-case search is O(n factorial times n), excluding output.
